provenance.note: The glass: the electric piano with the treble up — the modulator at 3.5x with a slower index decay. The patch is its own (what was `KEYBOARD_PRESETS`); the amplifier it plays through is the room's `keys` block, which all five share. Its timbre's loudness is MEASURED (2026-09-17, tools/loudness-fit.ts --timbres): this family alone in an eight-bar main groove, metered, less the level its room gave it, median over the themes that rolled it; it belongs to the instrument and not the room. The other three facts are read off the patch and held to it: struck where it is not an organ, the hold its sustain, the brightness its corner.

notes.attack: The envelope is the measured level at 300 ms and at the bar line, turned into an envelope: attack, decay and the sustain fraction.
notes.hpHz: The keys reach down into the band the kick body tops out in.
notes.tremoloHz: MEASURED: 27% of tracks carry a 4-7 Hz tremolo; the electric piano family has the highest AM prominence of the sustained families.
notes.edge: Round SPARK-1: the note's own oscillators high-passed at the place's corner and summed in after the lowpass, falling from the strike to a fraction of itself, and a few milliseconds of band-passed noise on the onset; a place writes it (the house's row). At rest its level and its strike are nought, which builds nothing, over the corners the house writes.
notes.knobs: The keyboard's ranges (PLAN-MODULATION M1): five patches behind one name, so each default is the median of the five — 1900/2600/1800/2500/2000 Hz of corner, 0.30/0.32/0.37/0.72/0.048 of sustain, 30/22/24/9/11 ms of attack — and what a knob moves is a factor on whichever patch is playing; a setting in absolute hertz would make one instrument out of five. The ceiling on brightness is the one the voice has always had: the note's own lowpass is clamped at 9 kHz. The grain (round SPARK-1) is a factor on the edge and the strike a place writes, one at the house; its measured slope is the keys alone under the house's edge against none, seed 1 theme two, +0.002 LU.
